mapper.sql: id, order_no as orderNo, user_id as userId, total_amount as totalAmount, status, shipping_address as shippingAddress, receiver_name as receiverName, receiver_phone as receiverPhone, remark, group_order_no as groupOrderNo, create_time as createTime, pay_time as payTime, ship_time as shipTime, receive_time as receiveTime
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO `order` (order_no, user_id, total_amount, status, shipping_address, receiver_name, receiver_phone, remark, group_order_no, create_time, pay_time, ship_time, receive_time) VALUES (#{orderNo}, #{userId}, #{totalAmount}, #{status}, #{shippingAddress}, #{receiverName}, #{receiverPhone}, #{remark}, #{groupOrderNo}, #{createTime}, #{payTime}, #{shipTime}, #{receiveTime})
mapper.select: SELECT o.id, o.order_no as orderNo, o.user_id as userId, o.total_amount as totalAmount, CASE WHEN o.status = 5 AND (SELECT MAX(rr.status) FROM return_request rr WHERE rr.order_id = o.id) = 4 THEN 3 ELSE o.status END as status, o.shipping_address as shippingAddress, o.receiver_name as receiverName, o.receiver_phone as receiverPhone, o.remark, o.group_order_no as groupOrderNo, o.create_time as createTime, o.pay_time as payTime, o.ship_time as shipTime, o.receive_time as receiveTime, o.express_company as expressCompany, o.tracking_no as trackingNo, p.pay_method as payMethod FROM `order` o LEFT JOIN payment p ON o.id = p.order_id WHERE o.id = #{id}

SELECT o.id, o.order_no as orderNo, o.user_id as userId, o.total_amount as totalAmount, CASE WHEN o.status = 5 AND (SELECT MAX(rr.status) FROM return_request rr WHERE rr.order_id = o.id) = 4 THEN 3 ELSE o.status END as status, o.shipping_address as shippingAddress, o.receiver_name as receiverName, o.receiver_phone as receiverPhone, o.remark, o.group_order_no as groupOrderNo, o.create_time as createTime, o.pay_time as payTime, o.ship_time as shipTime, o.receive_time as receiveTime, o.express_company as expressCompany, o.tracking_no as trackingNo, p.pay_method as payMethod FROM `order` o LEFT JOIN payment p ON o.id = p.order_id WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY o.create_time DESC
SELECT FROM `order` WHERE status = #{status} ORDER BY create_time DESC

SELECT o.id, o.order_no as orderNo, o.user_id as userId, o.total_amount as totalAmount, o.status, o.shipping_address as shippingAddress, o.receiver_name as receiverName, o.receiver_phone as receiverPhone, o.remark, o.group_order_no as groupOrderNo, o.create_time as createTime, o.pay_time as payTime, o.ship_time as shipTime, o.receive_time as receiveTime, p.pay_method as payMethod FROM `order` o LEFT JOIN payment p ON o.id = p.order_id WHERE o.user_id = #{userId} AND o.status = #{status} ORDER BY o.create_time DESC
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) FROM `order` o JOIN order_item oi ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE oi.merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND o.status <> 4

SELECT o.id, o.order_no as orderNo, o.total_amount as totalAmount, o.status, o.create_time as createTime FROM `order` o JOIN order_item oi ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE oi.merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND o.status IN (0, 1) ORDER BY o.create_time DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT DATE(o.create_time) as date, COUNT(DISTINCT o.id) as orderCount, COALESCE(SUM(o.total_amount), 0) as salesAmount FROM `order` o JOIN order_item oi ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE oi.merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND o.create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) AND o.status = 1 GROUP BY DATE(o.create_time) ORDER BY DATE(o.create_time) ASC
mapper.update: UPDATE `order` o JOIN order_item oi ON o.id = oi.order_id SET o.status = 1, pay_time = NOW() WHERE o.id = #{id} AND oi.merchant_id = #{merchantId} AND o.status = 0
mapper.select: SELECT oi.merchant_id FROM `order` o JOIN order_item oi ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.id = #{orderId} LIMIT 1

SELECT o.id, o.order_no as orderNo, o.status, o.ship_time as shipTime, oi.express_company as expressCompany, oi.tracking_no as trackingNo FROM `order` o LEFT JOIN order_item_ship oi ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.id = #{orderId} LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT o.id, o.order_no as orderNo, o.user_id as userId, o.total_amount as totalAmount, o.status, o.shipping_address as shippingAddress, o.receiver_name as receiverName, o.receiver_phone as receiverPhone, o.remark, o.group_order_no as groupOrderNo, o.create_time as createTime, o.pay_time as payTime, o.ship_time as shipTime, o.receive_time as receiveTime FROM `order` o JOIN order_item oi ON o.id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 0 AND o.create_time < #{timeoutTime}
mapper.update: UPDATE `order` SET status = 0 WHERE id = #{id} AND status = -1
mapper.select: SELECT o.id, o.order_no as orderNo, o.user_id as userId, o.total_amount as totalAmount, o.status, o.shipping_address as shippingAddress, o.receiver_name as receiverName, o.receiver_phone as receiverPhone, o.remark, o.group_order_no as groupOrderNo, o.create_time as createTime, o.pay_time as payTime, o.ship_time as shipTime, o.receive_time as receiveTime, u.username as userName, os.express_company as expressCompany, os.tracking_no as trackingNo, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ot.tag_name ORDER BY ot.create_time DESC) as tags, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT ot.tag_color ORDER BY ot.create_time DESC) as tagColors FROM `order` o JOIN order_item oi ON o.id = oi.order_id LEFT JOIN user u ON o.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN order_tag ot ON o.id = ot.order_id LEFT JOIN order_item_ship os ON o.id = os.order_id WHERE oi.merchant_id = #{merchantId} GROUP BY o.id ORDER BY o.create_time DESC LIMIT #{offset}, #{pageSize}
